arguments.query: SELECT region_code, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1
SELECT status, count(*), min(order_ts), max(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY 1
SELECT payment_status, count(*), sum(amount_twd) FROM payments GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.status, count(*) n, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status="ok")) paid_ok, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id)) shipped, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id)) refd FROM orders o GROUP BY 1
SELECT count(*), count(distinct order_id) FROM payments
SELECT count(*), count(distinct order_id) FROM order_items
SELECT o.status, count(distinct o.order_id) n, count(distinct p.order_id) pay_ok FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status="ok" GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(distinct s.order_id) shp FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(distinct r.order_id) ref FROM orders o JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents)/100.0/count(distinct o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1

SELECT count(*), sum(p.amount_twd), sum(i.t) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, sum(amount_twd) amount_twd FROM payments WHERE payment_status="ok" GROUP BY 1) p ON p.order_id=o.order_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, sum(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 t FROM order_items GROUP BY 1) i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE c.region_code="TW-N" AND o.order_ts>="2025-01-01" AND o.order_ts<"2026-01-01" AND o.status IN (1,2,3)

SELECT count(*), sum(abs(p.amount_twd - i.t)>0.5) FROM (SELECT order_id, sum(amount_twd) amount_twd FROM payments WHERE payment_status="ok" GROUP BY 1) p JOIN (SELECT order_id, sum(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 t FROM order_items GROUP BY 1) i ON i.order_id=p.order_id
